id.description: Unique identifier for the virtual extension.

firstName.description: First name of the virtual extension.

lastName.description: Last name of the virtual extension.

displayName.description: Full name of the virtual extension.

extension.description: Extension that the virtual extension is associated with.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number that the virtual extension is associated with.

locationName.description: Location name if the virtual extension is at the location level, empty if it is at the customer level.

locationId.description: Location ID if the virtual extension is at the location level, empty if it is at the customer level.

routeGroupId.description: Unique identifier of the route group.

trunkLocationName.description: Location of the trunk; required if `trunkName` is returned.

trunkLocationId.description: Location ID of the trunk; required if `trunkName` is returned.
